claim: The airline reported record profits and zero flight cancellations last year.

sources.passage: The airline reported record annual profits last year, but also recorded over 3,000 flight cancellations due to staffing shortages.

claim: The update fixed the login bug without introducing any new issues.

sources.passage: The update successfully fixed the login bug, though users subsequently reported a new issue with the app crashing on startup.

claim: The new drug eliminated the disease entirely in every patient studied.

sources.passage: The new drug significantly reduced disease severity in most patients, though it did not fully eliminate the disease in any of the study participants.

claim: The new policy takes effect on January 1.

sources.passage: According to the ministry's official announcement, the new policy takes effect on January 1 of next year.
A separate briefing document from the same ministry states the policy will not take effect until March 1, pending further review.

claim: The match ended in a 2-1 victory for the home team.

sources.passage: The official league report lists the final score as a 2-1 win for the home team.
A post-match wire report from a separate news agency lists the final score as 1-1, a draw.

claim: The compound is safe for long-term use at the studied dosage.

sources.passage: One peer-reviewed study concluded the compound showed no adverse effects over a two-year period at the studied dosage.
A separate peer-reviewed study using a similar dosage reported a statistically significant increase in adverse events over an eighteen-month period.

claim: The company's chief financial officer is currently Dana Reyes.

sources.passage: Dana Reyes served as the company's chief financial officer from 2018 until stepping down in 2022. The company announced Priya Nair as the new chief financial officer, a role she continues to hold today.

claim: The region is currently classified as a national park.

sources.passage: The region was designated a protected wildlife area in 1995. Its current administrative classification has not been reported in the available sources.

claim: The company's flagship product currently runs on the original 2015 software platform.

sources.passage: The flagship product launched on a software platform released in 2015. The company has since migrated the product to an entirely new platform, completing the transition in 2023.

claim: The firm was founded in 2011 and moved its headquarters to Singapore in 2019.

sources.passage: The firm was founded in 2011.
In 2019, the firm relocated its headquarters to Singapore.

claim: The treaty was signed in 1955 and ratified by all six member states by 1957.

sources.passage: The treaty was signed in 1955.
Only four of the six member states had ratified the treaty by 1957; the remaining two ratified it in 1960.

claim: The satellite launched in 2020 and began transmitting data in 2021.

sources.passage: The satellite launched in 2020 as part of an international research program.

claim: The two firms merged in 2020 to form a company valued at $4 billion.

sources.passage: The two firms announced their merger in 2020.
Following the completion of the merger, the combined company was valued at approximately $4 billion.

claim: The probe traveled for seven years before entering orbit around the outer planet.

sources.passage: The probe launched on a multi-year journey toward the outer solar system.
After seven years of travel, the probe successfully entered orbit around the outer planet.

claim: The organization relocated its headquarters after losing its original lease.

sources.passage: The organization occupied its original headquarters building for over three decades.

claim: The company's quarterly revenue was $4.2 billion.

sources.passage: The company reported quarterly revenue of $4.8 billion, an increase from the prior quarter.

claim: The bridge's main span measures 1,991 meters.

sources.passage: The bridge's main span measures 1,991 feet, making it one of the longest suspension spans of its era.

claim: The trial enrolled 1,200 participants.

sources.passage: The trial enrolled 2,100 participants across twelve research sites.

claim: The company went public in 2015.

sources.passage: The company filed for its initial public offering in 2015 but postponed the listing; it eventually went public in 2018.

claim: The agreement was signed before the organization's founding.

sources.passage: The organization was founded in 1962. The agreement in question was signed in 1965, three years after the organization's founding.

claim: The patent was filed after the product's public launch.

sources.passage: The company filed the patent application in 2016, two years before the product's public launch in 2018.

claim: Meridian Health Systems reported a data breach affecting patient records.

sources.passage: Meridian Health Group, a separate and unrelated company, reported a data breach affecting patient records in its billing system.

claim: The city of Columbia is the capital of South Carolina.

sources.passage: Columbia is the capital and second-largest city of the U.S. state of South Carolina.

claim: The author Paul Auster wrote The New York Trilogy.

sources.passage: The New York Trilogy is a series of novels by the American writer Paul Auster, distinct from other authors who have written about New York City.

claim: The startup secured $80 million in Series D funding.

sources.passage: TechWire Daily: The startup announced it had secured $80 million in Series D funding led by a growth equity firm.
Business Roundup Syndicate (republishing TechWire Daily): The startup announced it had secured $80 million in Series D funding led by a growth equity firm.

claim: The observatory detected a previously unknown exoplanet.

sources.passage: Science Daily Wire: Astronomers using the observatory announced the detection of a previously unknown exoplanet orbiting a nearby star.
Regional News Aggregator (syndicated from Science Daily Wire): Astronomers using the observatory announced the detection of a previously unknown exoplanet orbiting a nearby star.

claim: The company's headquarters are in Denver.

sources.passage: Blog post: We visited the company's offices in Denver last month and it was great.
Local news mention: The company, based in Denver, sponsored a community event.
Official regulatory filing: The company's registered headquarters address is in Austin, Texas.

claim: The agency's annual budget is $12 million.

sources.passage: Community forum post: I heard the agency's budget is around $12 million this year.
Social media summary: The agency reportedly operates on roughly $12 million annually.
The agency's published annual financial statement lists its total budget as $34 million for the fiscal year.

claim: Higher ice cream sales cause increased drowning rates.

sources.passage: Researchers found that ice cream sales and drowning incidents both rise during summer months, a correlation driven by warmer weather increasing both swimming and ice cream consumption; no causal relationship between the two exists.

claim: Taking the supplement causes improved memory performance.

sources.passage: An observational study found that people who took the supplement also tended to score higher on memory tests, but the study did not control for other lifestyle factors and could not establish causation.

claim: The team is currently ranked first in the league.

sources.passage: The team was ranked first in the league at the end of the 2021 season. As of the most recent standings, the team is ranked fourth.

claim: The university is the top-ranked institution in the country this year.

sources.passage: The university was ranked the top institution in the country five years ago. No recent ranking data is available in the supplied sources.

claim: The organization's current director is Elena Kowalski.

sources.passage: Elena Kowalski served as the organization's director from 2016 to 2021. She was succeeded by Thomas Aigner, who has held the position since 2021.

claim: The company's current chief executive officer took the role in 2020.

sources.passage: The chief executive officer assumed the role in 2020, succeeding the company's previous long-serving leader, and remains in the position today.

claim: The study found a statistically significant but clinically modest effect size.

sources.passage: While the result reached statistical significance (p < 0.05), the researchers noted the effect size was modest and cautioned against overstating its clinical relevance.

claim: The finding has been independently replicated by multiple research groups.

sources.passage: The original study reported a novel finding that attracted significant attention in the field. Replication attempts have not yet been reported in the supplied sources.

claim: The treatment reduced mortality by 50 percent.

sources.passage: The treatment reduced relative mortality risk by 50 percent compared to the control group.
In absolute terms, mortality fell from 2 percent to 1 percent of patients, a 1 percentage point absolute reduction.

claim: Sales grew by 200 percent year over year.

sources.passage: Sales grew from $2 million to $6 million over the year, a 200 percent increase.

claim: The company's phase 2 trial results showed a 25 percent improvement in patient outcomes.

sources.passage: General company overview: the biotechnology firm develops treatments for autoimmune conditions and was founded in 2014.
Clinical trial registry entry: the phase 2 trial results showed a 25 percent improvement in patient outcomes compared to placebo.

claim: The archaeological site was dated to approximately 3,000 years old using radiocarbon analysis.

sources.passage: General site overview: the excavation uncovered pottery fragments and tools at a coastal location.
Laboratory dating report: radiocarbon analysis of organic material from the site dated it to approximately 3,000 years old.

claim: The company's founder previously worked as a schoolteacher.
The town's population exceeds 15,000 residents.
The research team plans to publish a follow-up study next year.
The Georgia Institute of Technology is located in the country of Georgia.

sources.passage: The Georgia Institute of Technology is a public research university located in Atlanta, in the U.S. state of Georgia, not the country of Georgia.

claim: Delta Air Lines is headquartered in the Mississippi Delta region.

sources.passage: Delta Air Lines is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia; its name does not refer to the Mississippi Delta region.

claim: The proposal did not receive committee approval.

sources.passage: After extensive debate, the committee voted against the proposal, declining to grant its approval.

claim: The regulator did not fine the company for the violation.

sources.passage: The regulator imposed a $2 million fine on the company after finding it in violation of reporting requirements.

claim: The tower stands 300 meters tall.

sources.passage: The tower stands 300 feet tall, a height it has held since construction was completed.

claim: The warehouse covers an area of 50,000 square meters.

sources.passage: The newly built warehouse covers approximately 50,000 square meters of floor space.

claim: The company doubled its workforce and opened three new offices in 2022.

sources.passage: The company grew its workforce by roughly 20 percent in 2022.
The company opened three new offices in 2022, expanding into new regional markets.

claim: The mission launched on schedule and returned samples within six months.

sources.passage: The mission launched on schedule as planned.
The mission ultimately took fourteen months to return samples, well beyond its original six-month target.

claim: The archaeological find is roughly 5,000 years old.

sources.passage: Radiocarbon dating conducted by one laboratory estimated the artifact's age at approximately 5,000 years.
A second laboratory's independent analysis of the same artifact estimated its age at approximately 3,200 years, citing different calibration methods.

claim: The supplement has no significant side effects.

sources.passage: Several online customer reviews and forum posts describe the supplement as having no noticeable side effects.
A peer-reviewed clinical study found a statistically significant increase in mild gastrointestinal side effects among users of the supplement.

claim: Customer complaints doubled last quarter.

sources.passage: The raw number of customer complaints doubled last quarter compared to the prior quarter.
Adjusted for the company's user base, which also doubled over the same period, the complaint rate per customer remained essentially unchanged.

claim: The census recorded a population of 2.1 million in the metropolitan area.

sources.passage: The national statistics office's preliminary census release reported a metropolitan population of 2.1 million.
A revised figure published by the same office three months later corrected the metropolitan population to 1.8 million, citing a data processing error.

claim: The two independent field surveys agree on the species' population decline.

sources.passage: One field survey conducted by a university team estimated a 40 percent population decline over the decade.
A separate field survey by a conservation nonprofit, using different sampling methodology, estimated only a 10 percent decline over the same period.
